story: The Sri Lanka Spurfowl (Zoothera imbricata) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Turdidae family. It is most commonly observed in Moist evergreen forest; rural gardens; parks; plantations; and wet forest understory, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Near Threatened (NT) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Sri Lanka Spurfowl is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Sri Lanka Spurfowl into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
